renderPacket.identity: Seoul, real Gyeongbokgung palace complex viewed on a broad central axis with Bugaksan mountain rising directly behind the palace and enough contemporary Seoul context to read unmistakably as the Korean capital; palace roofs and dancheong are recognisable, mountain-city adjacency is clear, composition is wide and calm with text-safe negative space, soft clear autumn or spring daylight, restrained natural colors, no guard-change spectacle, no oversized crowd, no night neon, no readable signage, no fantasy palace scale.

Jeju, real Seongsan Ilchulbong tuff cone viewed from the Gwangchigi coastal side; recognisable broad crater-rim profile, basalt shore and shallow tidal foreground where plausible, soft clear daylight, restrained volcanic green/sea blue/dark basalt, no theatrical sunrise, no tropical-resort treatment.

Gyeongju Daereungwon, multiple overlapping grass-covered Silla royal tumuli in a broad park-like urban landscape; path and mature trees for scale, low city/hanok context subordinate, spring green or early autumn, no excavation display or fantasy burial reconstruction.

Andong Hahoe Village from a Buyongdae-style elevated viewpoint across the Nakdong River bend; clustered hanok and thatched houses, fields and wooded hills visible together, settlement pattern and river geography primary, late spring/summer green or restrained early autumn, no costume portrait or staged festival.

Seoraksan real Ulsanbawi multi-peak granite wall from a broad valley/mid-distance viewpoint; grey granite mass above mixed autumn forest with restrained natural reds/yellows/greens, crisp daylight, no fantasy snow, exaggerated cliffs or poster sky.

Suncheon Bay tidal wetland from an elevated Yongsan-Observatory-like viewpoint; winding tidal channels through reed beds and mudflat/shallow-water mosaics, broad wetland geometry primary, soft afternoon or early-evening light, tiny birds only if natural, no giant sun or saturated orange.

Busan Gamcheon, dense stepped houses on a steep hillside with port/sea context beyond where geographically plausible; layered alleys and roofs, varied but restrained color, people tiny and incidental, no Little Prince statue, mural close-up, readable signage or postcard saturation.

Boseong real tea fields, long curving rows following hillside contours with cedar/forest and low mountains; distant sea only if naturally visible from chosen viewpoint, early-summer green restrained rather than neon, no staged tea-picker portrait, product or sign.

Ulleungdo Taeha–Daepunggam coastal landscape, real steep volcanic/eroded sea cliffs, deep East Sea water and dense island vegetation from a plausible elevated viewpoint; infrastructure incidental, landscape primary, no tropical turquoise treatment, fantasy sea arches or exaggerated island walls.

Bibimbap in one simple bowl only: rice visible beneath/between clearly separated vegetable sections, modest beef only if integral, one egg component at centre, gochujang contained within the bowl; central dominant dish on plain warm ivory background, no banchan, utensils, soup or loose ingredients.

Tteokbokki in one shallow bowl only: cylindrical rice cakes clearly recognisable in red-orange sauce, restrained fish cake only if integral; central dominant dish on plain warm ivory background, no skewers, boiled-egg side, street-stall context, utensils or loose garnish.

Samgyetang in one simple earthenware-style or neutral bowl only: one small whole cooked chicken clearly visible in pale broth, rice/garlic/jujube/ginseng only as integral contents; central dominant dish on plain warm ivory background, no kimchi, side dishes, utensils or table setting.

Bulgogi in one shallow neutral plate or bowl only: thin cooked marinated beef slices with onion/scallion only where integral, moist realistic texture; central dominant dish on plain warm ivory background, no grill, lettuce wraps, rice, banchan, utensils or sauce bowls.
